chapter.verse: Vantung in Pasian’ minthan’na gen a, vanpi in ama nasepna taangko hi.
Ni simin thu gengen a, zan simin theihtelna pulaklak hi.
Pauna leh kammal om lo a, amau aw kiza lo hi;
ahih hangin a aw uh leitung khempeuh ah kizel a, a kammal uh leimong dongah tung hi. Ama sungah ni’ adingin omna khat bawl khin a,
ama inn sung pan-a hong pusuak zi pi tangval tawh ahi zongin, lungtaii tak-a tai dinga kipan mi thahat khat tawh ahi zongin kibang hi.
Ama suahna vanmong khat pan hi a, mong khat dongin pai a, nisa bangin ama satna a liah bangmah om lo hi.
Topa ’ thu kicing a, nuntakna thaksuak sak hi; Topa ’ teci pan’na pen hi takpi a, mipil lote pil sak hi;
Topa ’ thuhilhte man a, lungsim nuam sak hi; Topa ’ thupiakna siang a, mitte vaaksak hi.
Topa a kizahtakna in siang a, kip tawntung hi; Topa ’ ngeina kipte thuman a, a vekpi-in kituak takin man kim hi.
Kham sangin ahi zongin, kham siangte nangawn sangin ahi zongin tuate deihhuai zaw a, khuaizu leh khuailuzu tak sangin zong khumzaw hi.
Tham loin tuate hangin na nasempa in thu phawkna ngah a, tuate zuihna-ah noptuam lian om hi.
Ahih hangin kua in ama khialhnate kimukhia thei hiam? Theih loh man-a khialnate panin hong siangsak in.
Mawh kaltangnate panin zong na nasempa hong kem in la, tuate keima tungah hong uk sak kei in! Tua ciangin kawk ka baang kei ding a, mawhna lian panin ka siang ding hi.
Topa, ka suangpi leh keimah hong tankhiapa aw, ka kammal leh ka lungsim ngaihsutnate nangma muhna-ah san’huai suak sak ta in!
